LESSON: GOVERNMENT AND BUSINESS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.2: Government and Business
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Government and Business, part of Entrepreneurship in Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important for the Government to get involved in business?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm and present on the reasons for government involvement in business in Kenya,

2. use print or digital media to search for information on ways of Government involvement in business,

3. discuss and present on the meaning and importance of paying taxes in Kenya,

4. discuss types of taxes in Kenya (income tax, VAT, corporate tax, fuel levy, excise duty) and present to peers,

5. discuss a case scenarios on e- Government services in business such as registration and licensing of motor vehicle business by NTSA, among others,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm and present on the reasons for government involvement in business in Kenya,
2. use print or digital media to search for information on ways of Government involvement in business,
3. discuss and present on the meaning and importance of paying taxes in Kenya,
4. discuss types of taxes in Kenya (income tax, VAT, corporate tax, fuel levy, excise duty) and present to peers,
5. discuss a case scenarios on e- Government services in business such as registration and licensing of motor vehicle business by NTSA, among others,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Government and Business together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving; learner develops evaluating and decision making skills when discussing a case

scenario on e- Government services in business.

• Digital Literacy: learner develops the skill of interacting with technology when using digital devices to access and interact

with the e- Government platform in Kenya.

Values:
• Responsibility: learner acquires accountability skills when using digital devices to access and interact with e- Government

platform in Kenya taxes in Kenya.

• Social justice: learner learns about the need for government involvement in business to promote fairness and equity across

the society.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Financial Literacy: learner enhances financial skills when discussing and presenting on types of taxes paid in Kenya.

• Social Cohesion: learner enhances interpersonal relationships when brainstorming and presenting on the reasons for

government involvement in business.

Link to other Subjects:

Social Studies: learner enhances knowledge on taxation when discussing the types of taxes.
